components.name: Active Button
components.description: A compact square layer button filled with sunlight.
components.css: .ds-active { padding: 4px 10px; color: #181a1e; background: #e3ad32; border: 1px solid #181a1e; border-radius: 0; font: 14px/1.45 Carlito, Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #805300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A square sheet field with a strong keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 220px; padding: 5px 8px; color: #181a1e; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #6d767b; border-radius: 0; font: 14px/1.45 Carlito, Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #805300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Quiet view names with a thick sunlight active rule and a separate full-width status rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #181a1e; font: 14px/1.45 Carlito, Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { position: relative; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 10px; color: #59646c; background: transparent; border: 0; } .ds-nav button[aria-pressed=true] { color: #181a1e; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px #e3ad32; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #805300; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Status Rail
components.description: Operational counts use outline for quiet states and filled semantic squares for active problems, with live connection state at the far edge.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; color: #181a1e; background: #ffffff; border-block: 1px solid #c7c6bb; font: 700 13px/1.4 Carlito, Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-status span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; border-left: 1px solid #c7c6bb; } .ds-status span:first-child { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-status .warning { color: #9a5700; } .ds-status .warning i { background: currentColor; } .ds-status strong { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; } .ds-status strong i { border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: #167a45; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: A square table with a raised header plane and alternating quiet rows.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #181a1e; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #6d767b; font: 13px/1.45 Carlito, Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7c6bb; } .ds-table th { background: #eeede2; border-bottom: 2px solid #181a1e; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f6f5ea; }

components.name: Port Faceplate
components.description: A framed device plane with pattern and border based port states.
components.css: .ds-face { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 18px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #181a1e; } .ds-port { width: 28px; height: 24px; padding: 0; color: #181a1e; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #6d767b; border-radius: 0; } .ds-trunk { background: #e3ad32; border: 2px solid #181a1e; } .ds-shut { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #f6f5ea 0 3px, #c7c6bb 3px 5px); } .ds-lag { border: 2px dashed #805300; } .ds-port:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #805300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Graph States
components.description: Illustrated network devices whose selection, warning and outside states remain distinct without color.
components.html: <svg class="ds-graph" viewBox="0 0 360 80"><rect class="selected" x="10" y="20" width="90" height="36"/><rect class="warning" x="135" y="20" width="90" height="36"/><rect class="outside" x="260" y="20" width="90" height="36"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-graph { width: 360px; background: #f6f5ea; } .ds-graph rect { fill: #ffffff; } .ds-graph .selected { stroke: #e3ad32; stroke-width: 5; } .ds-graph .warning { stroke: #9a5700; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 10 3; } .ds-graph .outside { stroke: #6d767b; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 2 4; }

narrative.overview: Circuit uses large architectural planes, charcoal structure, limewash ground and a rare sunlight accent. Documentation gives the system room to persuade and explain. Studio compresses the same materials into a dense operating tool without changing identity.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: Sunlight marks the active plane or one structural emphasis, never unrelated categories.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Error, warning and up colors are semantic only and always have a second cue.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from scale, overlap and structural borders. Decorative shadow, glow, blur and glass do not belong.

dos: Keep docs and Studio on shared tokens.
Design every semantic color for light and dark.
Pair status color with dashes, hatching, weight or text.
donts: Do not restore terracotta, serif headings, pills or trace decoration.
Do not use neon terminal or monitoring dashboard styling.
Do not borrow a vendor palette.
Do not use soft shadows, blur or glass.
